correctness.rationale: For each N≥2 and coprime a, the parity-adjusted chirp is N-periodic and has vanishing nonzero shift autocorrelations. Let d=∏p^floor(v/2), m=N/d, with d|m. Grouping correlations by j mod d proves ALL d-periodic phases remain exact CAZAC; for shifts divisible by m the modulation cancels. The first variation of each shifted autocorrelation is iγ_s(e^(−2πia s²/N)−1)√N \hat h(−as), so the energy quadratic term is 4N Σ_{s≠0}sin²(π a s²/N)|\hat h(−as)|² and the Hessian eigenvalues are 8Nsin²(πa^{-1}k²/N). Its null modes satisfy N|s², i.e. m|s and frequency k multiple m, exactly the d-dimensional periodic phase subspace. The transverse Hessian has gap 8Nσ; continuity and line integration give E≥2Nσ dist(θ,T_d)² locally, eliminating all other nearby CAZAC branches. Independently computed correlations and FFT Hessian quadratic form for every coprime a at N=2,4,8,9,12,16,18,25; finite checks confirm coefficients only, not infinite quantifiers.
